channel.title: Paul Tinker AI log
channel.description: Designing and building digital products with AI: Kavvi and Edgey shipped to both app stores, TOBi rethought for generative AI, and design systems rebuilt with AI.

item.title: TOBi, rethought for generative AI
item.description: I designed TOBi, Vodafone's chatbot, before today's generative models. Looking at it again: what changes when the AI can say anything, and what doesn't.

item.title: Kavvi: a product designed and shipped end to end
item.description: A renewals app for families: design system, iPhone and Android apps, docs, Storybook and a live site. I made the decisions; AI did the building.

item.title: Governance in an AI-native world
item.description: Governance in an AI-native world: an agent that decides before it builds, a front door anyone in the company can use, and a person who still makes the call.

item.title: Edgey: a game from concept to both stores
item.description: An idea I'd had for years, taken all the way to Google Play and the App Store: app, site, brand and backend. I designed it and directed the build, and the first time the whole product was mine.

item.title: Source and Keystone: two design systems, rebuilt with AI
item.description: The two largest design systems I've worked on, rebuilt first as interactive design artifacts, then as real front-end code with Storybook and docs from one source.

item.title: Bridge: an AI-native product and design system
item.description: An AI-native product and design system: a multi-brand e-commerce prototype, designed and built through prompts.
